title: Node.send local delivery leaks SCHC validation exceptions
description: Node.send documents a boolean success result and catches SCHC policy errors on the forwarding path, but its DELIVER_LOCAL branch calls compress_packet(ipv6_bytes) without handling SchcError/ValueError/TypeError. IPv6Packet.from_bytes(strict=True) does not validate UDP checksums, while the newly hardened compress_packet does, so a locally addressed IPv6/UDP packet with a zero or bad checksum raises out of Node.send instead of returning False. Apply the same bounded failure handling as the forwarding path and add local-destination invalid-transport regression coverage.
